questions.placeholder: Just the facts, in a few lines…

questions.placeholder: One thing you can put down tonight…

templates.line: Something stuck with you? Look at it kindly

questions.placeholder: Describe it as if telling a friend…

questions.text: What did I feel, and where in my body?
questions.placeholder: Tight chest, heavy shoulders, racing thoughts…

questions.placeholder: Be as kind to yourself as you would be to them…

templates.title: Let it out
templates.line: Write freely, then keep it or let it go

templates.title: Free write
templates.line: A blank page, your own words

prompts.text: What took the most out of you today, and what gave something back?
Who made your shift a little easier today?
What is one thing you handled better than you expected?
What are you still carrying from work that you can put down?
What moment from today do you want to remember?
What would make tomorrow's shift feel a little lighter?
How is your body feeling right now, after today?
What is on your mind as the shift begins?
What is one small thing you can do for yourself today?
How did you sleep, and what helped or got in the way?
What are you looking forward to today, even a little?
What do you want to bring to your patients today?
What has been on repeat in your head lately?
When did you last feel properly rested? What was different?
What boundary would protect your energy this week?
What is something you are proud of that nobody saw?
Who could you reach out to this week, just to talk?
What does a good day off look like for you?
What is one worry you can write down and leave here?
What made you smile recently, at work or at home?

savedLines.light: There is a lot of warmth in what you wrote.
savedLines.mixed: Some hard moments, and some good ones too.
savedLines.heavy: That sounds like a heavy one. Be gentle with yourself tonight.
savedLines.none: This entry is too short to read its tone.

support.notes: Lower-case phrase match on the whole entry text after removing punctuation and collapsing spaces. Any match shows the support card instead of the tone. Never store a flag, never log the match, never send it anywhere.

card.title: Thank you for writing this down.
card.body: Some of what you wrote sounds really heavy. You do not have to carry it alone. Talking to someone can help right now.
card.footnote: If you are in danger right now, call your local emergency number. MindMate is not an emergency service.

practiceSuggestions.notes: Ids match meditation_sessions.json. Hide the card if the meditation module or the id is missing.
